blocking_findings.title: Selected-checkpoint extraction is reported as first-stage pretraining cost
blocking_findings.finding: anchor_pretraining_cost.runtime copies anchor['runtime']. This object measures the selected checkpoint's final query/gallery extraction, not the completed 50-epoch anchor training. The required two-stage cost report therefore omits first-stage training wall time while presenting extraction runtime under pretraining cost.
